name: Micro SMG
summary: Ultra-compact open-bolt submachine gun delivering blistering fire rates perfectly suited for vehicle drive-bys and tight interior room clearing.
description: Modeled after the iconic Ingram MAC-10, the Micro SMG unloads its 30-round magazine in seconds. Compact enough to be operated one-handed from vehicle windows and motorcycles, this submachine gun is standard issue for Vice City gang hit squads.

seo.title: Micro SMG: Fire Rate, Drive-By Capabilities & Specs
seo.description: Guide to the Micro SMG in GTA VI. MAC-10 fire rates, vehicle drive-by handling, drum magazines, and underground gun van spawns.
